brand_notes: Polk US lists all bookshelf models current (Reserve R100/R200, Signature Elite ES15/ES20, T15, Monitor XT15/XT20). Nominal impedance is not stated for ES/XT/Reserve ('compatible with 4- and 8-ohm outputs'); only T-Series info sheet rates T15 at 8 ohm. Measured minima for ES20 3.6, XT15/XT20 about 4.0, T15 about 4.1 ohm: all effectively 4 ohm designs. Design traits: Terylene dome tweeters, Dynamic Balance cones, budget price, 5-year warranty, Vietnam manufacture (tnt-audio XT15). T15 deliberately voiced to be flatter 20 degrees above/below the tweeter (Polk VP engineering quoted by Audioholics).
takeaways: Poorest measured: LW ±7.1 dB, f3 88 Hz, 3-6 kHz on-axis hole, ER dip 6.2 dB
